text:
anita: Brief sync after the postmortem. We split follow-ups into three small owners: quota guard, scheduler attenuation, and runway alerts. Want clear acceptance tests and owners so these close quickly.

ben: I'll take quota guard. Idea: implement a lightweight quota controller that enforces a per-pool soft floor and triggers spillover for excess batch work. Default soft_floor=10% for interactive pools. ETA 4 business days.

carlos: I'll own scheduler attenuation. Plan: lower packing aggressiveness for batch jobs, add a 20s damp window post-eviction, and run a 5-day trace replay for validations.

anita: infra-team, can you expose pool.reserved_pct, pool.avg_mem_frac(1m) and add a simple synthetic metric: runway_linear_minutes? Ops wants a quick card.

infra-team: yes. We'll add the metrics and the API field desired_headroom_pct on /pools/:id. PR by EOD tomorrow.

ben: Acceptance test (quota guard):
```
# acceptance
ramp(batch_qps=3.5x, duration=900s)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 10%)
expect(alert='quota_soft', within=90s)
expect(pager='quota_hard', if=sustained(>93%, 300s))
```

carlos: Scheduler plan details: new eviction scoring to try in staging: `score = mem_frac*1.4 + cpu_frac*0.6 + age_secs*0.001`. Evict damp = 20000ms. I'll post p50/p95/p99 and pack/unpack latencies.

anita: for runway alert short-circuit: if runway_linear_minutes < 30 AND growth_rate > 4%/m then preemptive scale + page (15m cooldown). Start with linear only; model output can be an extra column.

sre-bot: Created follow-ups: ITEM-9001 (quota-guard) assigned to ben, ITEM-9002 (scheduler-attenuation) assigned to carlos, ITEM-9003 (runway-card) assigned to infra-team. Due dates: 2024-07-19, 2024-07-17, 2024-07-15.

ben: I'll add the quota acceptance test to CI gates so merges require passing. Also plan to implement spill-to-delay-queue rather than rejecting background jobs on hard threshold.

carlos: blocker: need historical per-job mem_frac histograms for 45 days to pick weights. @infra-team can you backfill?

infra-team: Backfill scheduled; ETA ~3h. We'll also expose the new API field in the same PR.

anita: small operational note: add a recurring 3-week check-in to the postmortem follow-ups and assign a Monday SRE to review headroom trend.

sre-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-ups updated: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1934567890.

ben: quick question 1: what's our acceptance window for cost regression? We should limit token-cost increase to <5% for the scheduler change.

carlos: agree. I'll include token-cost delta in the sim outputs and aim for <5% increase; if higher, we'll iterate.

anita: ownership recap: ben -> ITEM-9001 quota-guard (4d), carlos -> ITEM-9002 scheduler-attenuation (2d sims + 5d to ship), infra-team -> ITEM-9003 runway-card + API (1d). Check-in in 72 hours here. Any blockers?

carlos: none immediate 1 will post sim numbers in ~24h.

ben: adding acceptance harness to repo now and will link CI job.

anita: thanks team. If anything slips escalate in this thread. :white_check_mark:
